messages:
anika: quick heads-up: I opened a small PR to reconcile the autoscale policy examples in the Dedicated handbook (migration section). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2510. Need someone to sanity-check the cooldown values + isolation wording.

mike: looking. which cooldowns did you pick? we should avoid hard defaults that teams copy blindly.

anika: current draft proposes 30s scaleUp, 300s scaleDown, maxBurst=1 for latency-sensitive tenants, and a short note that burst instances are preemptible.

sara: LGTM but suggest showing a labeled example for "latency-sensitive" vs "throughput-optimized":
```yaml
# latency-sensitive
autoscalePolicy:
  minInstances: 2
  scaleUpCooldown: 30s
  scaleDownCooldown: 300s
  maxBurstInstances: 1

# throughput-optimized
autoscalePolicy:
  minInstances: 1
  scaleUpCooldown: 60s
  scaleDownCooldown: 180s
  maxBurstInstances: 3
```

docsbot: CI: lint OK. linkcheck: no broken links.

mike: nice. small copy nit: replace 'tenant' with 'account' in the examples to match onboarding doc language. I'll push that tiny edit.
anika: thanks — once the wording change is in and legal has the SLA snippet (separate PR) I'll merge. tagging owners in PR description: docs (anika), infra (mike), SDK (sara).
